name: Can a bathtub alcove be converted into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can an existing tub alcove be converted into a walk-in shower without rebuilding the whole bathroom?
mainEntity.text: Can an existing tub alcove be converted into a walk-in shower without rebuilding the whole bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathtub alcove is one of the most common spaces to convert into a walk-in shower because the footprint already exists. That can reduce demolition and make the remodel more efficient than moving walls or expanding the room. Even so, a proper conversion still requires more than simply removing the tub and adding tile. The shower area needs correct waterproofing, a drain system that handles daily use, wall preparation that supports tile or panel systems, and a layout that controls splashing. If the old tub alcove has hidden damage, poor framing, or outdated plumbing, those issues need to be corrected before the new shower goes in. Many homeowners also choose to add shelving, a bench, or better lighting during the conversion since the space is already open. A tub-to-shower conversion can be a strong value upgrade when designed for comfort, water control, and long-term durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a bathtub alcove can often be converted into a walk-in shower with less demolition than a full layout change. The existing walls, plumbing wall, and footprint may be reused, but waterproofing, drainage, and wall backer preparation still need to be upgraded. The final result depends on the condition of the existing structure.
